beats.say: at 86, a life as long as a working week every year, with 60 years on stage and screen.
He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II in 2010 for his services to drama.
Sir Patrick Stewart appeared in the world's longest-running play, The Mousetrap.
A legacy that long leaves a mark on every generation; what is your favourite Patrick Stewart role?
